attempted_claim: Let n ≥ 5, let π be a group, and let τ be the twist determined by the normal 1-type of an almost-spin closed smooth n-manifold. Is every class in the kernel of the twisted Dirac (Atiyah–Bott–Shapiro) orientation U_*^{Spin,τ}: Ω_n^{Spin,τ}(Bπ) → ko_n^τ(Bπ) representable by a closed smooth n-manifold admitting a Riemannian metric of positive scalar curvature?
decisive_failure: No complete proof or disproof of the twisted bordism Stolz claim was obtained; the twisted HP^2-transfer split above E2 remains obstructed by the phi-twisted Steenrod action (Hebestreit-Joachim Theorem 7.2.5), and the E2-level PSC check plus literature triage in output/artifacts/ are supporting working notes only, not an independent result.
